reasons.plausibility: Dispersion strengthening with Y2O3 is a well-known and sound approach for enhancing high-temperature performance of metallic alloys, though its exact efficacy and optimal concentrations in refractory HEAs remain somewhat uncertain.
reasons.testability: The hypothesis includes a clear, controlled experiment (introducing 0.5–1 at.% Y2O3 vs. baseline) and well-defined success criteria (≥10% improvement) under specified conditions, so it is readily testable and falsifiable.
reasons.usefulness: It provides a concrete, scientifically grounded intervention that addresses the research goal of boosting high-temperature properties without sacrificing density or low-temperature performance, which is valuable to researchers in this field.
